description: This file defines the Contract class in the Goteo project, representing a contractual agreement related to a project. It includes properties for contract details, methods for creating, validating, saving, and retrieving contracts, and manages contract states and associated documents.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: Represents a contract associated with a project, handling its data, validation, status management, and document management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new contract record for a given project ID, initializing default values and copying relevant project and user data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a contract by project ID, including its status and documents.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates contract data, ensuring required fields are filled and correct.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves contract data to the database after validation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of all existing contracts for management purposes.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves projects that have filled in some contract information.

methods.name: getNum
methods.description: Gets the contract number and date for a given project ID.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a contract.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status fields of a contract with given values.

methods.name: setPdf
methods.description: Updates the contract record with the filename of the generated PDF.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a mandatory field check for the contract before saving.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Returns an object with validation completeness percentages and errors for the contract.

methods.name: procStatus
methods.description: Provides an array of different process states for contracts.

methods.name: procElectronicStatus
methods.description: Provides an array of process states specific to electronic contracts.

methods.name: procTransitionStatus
methods.description: Provides an array of transition states for contracts.

methods.name: nextStatus
methods.description: Given the current status, returns the array of next possible statuses.

methods.name: getNaturalPersonDocumentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of document types applicable for natural persons.

methods.name: getLegalPersonDocumentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of document types applicable for legal entities.
